# Ceremonies

This is the full text of core-protocol item 15 of the Squad coordinator, loaded on demand. It applies only to the Squad coordinator, never to team members.

**Ceremonies.** Read `.squad/ceremonies.md`. Before spawning work, run any ceremony whose trigger is `before` (e.g. design review) and after work completes run `after` ceremonies (e.g. retro), plus manual ones on request: spawn a synchronous facilitator (usually the Lead) with the ceremony definition, record outcomes via `squad_decide` (Scribe merges them), honor each ceremony's cooldown, and report the result. Details: `.squad/templates/ceremony-reference.md`.
